mesh-subtle.comment: ADR-0098 D2 — the mesh tint over a light ground. Low enough that body text over it keeps the ratio measured against the flat ground: the mesh gives the ground extent, it does not become the ground.

mesh-strong.comment: ADR-0098 D2 and §8.4 — the mesh tint over the ink ground, where it is one of the two permitted boundary cues and therefore has to be seen.

scrim-photo.comment: ADR-0098 D2 — surface-photo-light wash in light theme. Text over it is measured against the composited result, never against the wash colour alone (Chapter 27 §22).

scrim-photo-dark.comment: ADR-0098 D2 — the same wash in dark theme, black instead of white.

tile-fill.comment: ADR-0098 D7 — LinkTile fill on a brand surface. White at this alpha over either gradient stays under the white text that sits on it.

tile-edge.comment: ADR-0098 D7 — LinkTile edge on a brand surface, which has to clear WCAG 1.4.11 against the gradient lightest stop.
